description: Get one FickelUSA product by id: name, category, image, and how to buy. Most products that are not apparel or headwear include buy_url (the fickelusa.com page where the buyer completes the purchase). Apparel, headwear, and screen-printed products use request_quote instead, because the artwork is reviewed through a quote (minimum 100 pieces). request_quote remains available for custom or large orders. FICKEL does not take payment.
name: get_product
title: Get a FICKEL product
